import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox
import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

def browse_directory(directory_var):
    file_path = filedialog.askdirectory()
    if file_path:
        directory_var.set(file_path)

def open_window():
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.title("Inputs de Fetching")
    root.geometry("500x200")

    ticker_var = tk.StringVar()
    start_date_var = tk.StringVar()
    end_date_var = tk.StringVar()
    directory_var = tk.StringVar()

    ticker_label = tk.Label(root, text="Símbolo do ticker:")
    ticker_label.grid(row=0, column=0, padx=5, pady=5)
    ticker_entry = tk.Entry(root, textvariable=ticker_var)
    ticker_entry.grid(row=0, column=1, padx=5, pady=5)

    start_date_label = tk.Label(root, text="Data inicial (AAAA-MM-DD):")
    start_date_label.grid(row=1, column=0, padx=5, pady=5)
    start_date_entry = tk.Entry(root, textvariable=start_date_var)
    start_date_entry.grid(row=1, column=1, padx=5, pady=5)

    end_date_label = tk.Label(root, text="Data final (AAAA-MM-DD):")
    end_date_label.grid(row=2, column=0, padx=5, pady=5)
    end_date_entry = tk.Entry(root, textvariable=end_date_var)
    end_date_entry.grid(row=2, column=1, padx=5, pady=5)

    directory_label = tk.Label(root, text="Caminho do diretório:")
    directory_label.grid(row=3, column=0, padx=5, pady=5)
    directory_entry = tk.Entry(root, textvariable=directory_var)
    directory_entry.grid(row=3, column=1, padx=5, pady=5)
    directory_button = tk.Button(root, text="Selecionar diretório", command=lambda: browse_directory(directory_var))
    directory_button.grid(row=3, column=2, padx=5, pady=5)

    fetch_button = tk.Button(root, text="Buscar Dados", command=lambda: fetch_data(ticker_var.get(), start_date_var.get(), end_date_var.get(), directory_var.get()))
    fetch_button.grid(row=4, column=0, columnspan=2, padx=5, pady=10)

    root.mainloop()

def fetch_data(ticker, start_date, end_date, directory):
    if not ticker or not start_date or not end_date or not directory:
        messagebox.showerror("Erro", "Todos os campos devem ser preenchidos")
        return

    try:
        data = yf.download(ticker, start=start_date, end=end_date)
        csv_path = f"{directory}/{ticker}.csv"
        data.to_csv(csv_path)
        messagebox.showinfo("Sucesso", f"Dados salvos em: {csv_path}")

    except Exception as e:
        messagebox.showerror("Erro", str(e))

open_window()

While most people are aware of the popping sound that a tennis ball can make when you first open it, due to the pressure inside of the can, many people think that these are the only kinds of tennis balls there are. Why Are Tennis Ball Cans Pressurized?

What Are Pressure-Less Tennis Balls?

Pressurized and pressure-less tennis balls are different in many ways. Typically, two metrics are used to evaluate a K-means model.

1. Sum of square errors (SSE) within clusters
2. Silhouette score.

SSE within clusters is derived by summing up the squared distance between each data point and its closest centroid. The goal is to reduce the error value. The intuition behind this is that we would want the distance of each data point to be as close as possible to the centroid. If the error is small, it would mean that the data points in the same cluster are relatively similar. As the number of centroids (clusters) increase, the error value will decrease. As such we would need to rely on the next metric to ensure that we are not introducing too many centroids (clusters) in the model.

Silhouette score is a measure of how similar the data point is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. The value ranges from -1 (worst score) to 1 (best score). A negative value would mean that data points are wrongly clustered while values near 0 would mean that there are overlapping clusters.

They were held by the police on a roundabout on the main road, while the counter-demo was outside the front of the hotel, kettled between a fence and a police line. Trade unionists, the left, and students, along with migrant action groups, turned out in significant numbers, with three coaches and a convoy of cars. Sheffield Trades Union Council organised and funded coaches from Sheffield. Without that, numbers would have been much smaller. A small group did break through to confront the group of fascists on the roundabout, then were surrounded and brought back to the designated zone. Placards from Sheffield Solidarity Group stood out with the slogan "Jobs and Homes not Racism". def bubbling(arr):

    :return: 新的列表
    """
    new_list = list(arr)

    for i in range(1, len(new_list)):

            if new_list[j] > new_list[j + 1]:
                temp = new_list[j]
                new_list[j] = new_list[j + 1]

Für die Fans des Animationsfilms ist die französische Vor-Alpenstadt Annecy das, was Cannes für Kinofans ist. Jedes Jahr im Juni findet hier das berühmte Animationsfilmfestival statt. Es wurde 1960 gegründet und hat sich schnell zu einem der wichtigsten Festivals weltweit entwickelt. Hunderte Animationsfilme laufen im Wettbewerb. Es gibt studentische Abschlussarbeiten genauso zu sehen wie Kurzfilme oder kostenintensive Studio-Produktionen.

Auf dem Programm 2023 stehen 468 Filme - von Premieren, Sneak Peeks, über Outdoor-Screenings jeden Abend, bis hin zu exklusiven Filmvorführungen und einem "Pride and Diversity"-Programm. Dieses Jahr wurde der Start des Festivals durch eine blutige Messerattacke auf Kinder überschattet. Inzwischen hat sich herausgestellt, dass es sich um eine Einzeltat handelte. In Absprache mit den Behörden und mit dem Bürgermeister von Annecy, sollte das Festival offiziell zwar am 11. Juni 2023 beginnen, doch die Organisatoren haben als Zeichen der Solidarität mit den Familien und den Opfern der Messerattacke beschlossen, den Beginn der Freiluftvorführungen auf Montag, den 12. Juni, zu verschieben. Im Pressecommuniqué heißt es: "Die Vorführungen des Festivals stehen im Zeichen der Werte, die wir immer verteidigt haben: Gemeinschaftssinn, Solidarität und Brüderlichkeit."

Die Zukunft des Animationsfilms

Neben den Vorführungen von verschiedenen Animationsfilmen und dem Wettbewerb ist das Filmfestival von Annecy auch der größte internationale Markt für Animationsfilme. Es finden dort deshalb auch Vorträge zu den Themen statt, die sich in den kommenden Jahren in der Animationsbranche rasant weiterentwickeln werden: darunter Echtzeit-Animation, KI und anderen neuen Technologien.

Auch der Einsatz von Virtual Reality wird beim Festival in Vortragsreihen und sogar in einer Wettbewerbssektion behandelt. Auf VR-Reisen können sich Zuschauer in die Psyche eines psychisch labilen Künstlers begeben, in den verwirrten Kopf einer Abtreibungsgegnerin, die ihr Kind abgetrieben hat, oder eines britischen Bombenfliegers, der ein Gestapo-Hauptquartier zerstören will.

Myelin helps to speed up the transmission of electrical signals in the nervous system and is crucial for proper brain function.

Oligodendrocytes can be divided into two main groups: the mature oligodendrocytes that form the insulating covers of neurons and the star-shaped precursor cells that give rise to the mature oligodendrocytes.

During development, precursor cells divide into two main types: oligodendrocyte precursor cells (OPCs) and neurons. OPCs then migrate to the brain and begin to differentiate into mature oligodendrocytes.

As they differentiate, mature oligodendrocytes begin to wrap around the axon of a neuron, forming a myelin sheath. The more mature the oligodendrocyte, the thicker and compacter its myelin sheath becomes.

The process of oligodendrocyte differentiation is complex and involves a series of steps, including the production of specific proteins and the formation of specialized structures called nodes of Ranvier.

Oligodendrocytes are important for the proper functioning of the nervous system, and their loss or damage can lead to a range of neurological disorders, including Multiple Sclerosis, Alzheimer's, and certain forms of dementia.

Eine Reihe von Studien legt dies nahe. So zeigten junge, gesunde Probanden bereits nach sechs Wochen Lauftraining deutliche Verbesserungen in ihrem räumlichen Vorstellungsvermögen. Auch in Tests, die die so genannten exekutiven Funktionen abfragen, schnitten sie besser ab. Das bedeutet: Sie konnten sich besser konzentrieren und ihr Verhalten besser steuern. Der Sportwissenschaftler Ralf K. Reinhardt, der die Studie im Rahmen seiner Doktorarbeit an der Universität Karlsruhe durchführte, erklärte das unter anderem mit Veränderungen im Dopaminstoffwechsel.

Dopamin ist ein wichtiger Botenstoff. Er wird von bestimmten Nervenzellen im Vorderhirn gebildet und sorgt dafür, dass Signale weitergeleitet werden. Der Neurotransmitter ist sowohl an motorischen als auch an geistigen und emotionalen Reaktionen beteiligt. Schütten wir viel davon aus, fühlen wir uns gut und setzen eine bestimmte Aktivität eher fort, zum Beispiel Sport oder Lernen. Dopamin wird daher auch als Glücks- oder Motivationshormon bezeichnet. Abgebaut wird der Botenstoff unter anderem durch das Enzym Catechol-O-Methyltransferase, kurz COMT. Es kommt beim Menschen in zwei Versionen vor: Die eine baut Dopamin etwas schneller, die andere etwas langsamer ab. Hat man das Glück, mit der langsamen Isoform ausgestattet zu sein, kann das ausgeschüttete Dopamin länger wirken. Bei bestimmten kognitiven Tests haben solche Personen daher wohl einen Vorteil.

Il englobe un large éventail de missions visant à garantir la qualité des informations publiées par les entreprises et à renforcer la confiance des parties prenantes. Parmi ces missions, l'audit des états financiers occupe une place centrale en tant que processus d'évaluation indépendant et objectif qui atteste de l'exactitude des états financiers présentés par une entité.

La crédibilité de l'audit légal est essentielle pour orienter les décisions d'investissement des acteurs économiques, car elle permet de prendre des décisions éclairées sur l'allocation des capitaux. En tant que "gardien de la vérité sur les marchés", la profession d'audit est perçue comme étant chargée de préserver la confiance du public dans les rapports financiers (Paul A. Volcker, 2002).

Néanmoins, malgré l'importance capitale de cette mission, des inquiétudes persistent quant à l'efficacité globale de l'audit. L'écart entre les attentes des parties prenantes concernant l'audit et les performances réelles des auditeurs, connu sous le nom de "audit expectations gap", soulève des doutes quant à la qualité des audits (Porter, 1990). Les récents scandales financiers, tels que l'affaire "Wirecard" impliquant EY, ont ravivé ces inquiétudes et remis en question la crédibilité de l'audit (Financial Times, 2020).

Pour mieux appréhender la qualité de l'audit légal, il est essentiel de comprendre comment les auditeurs appliquent les normes d'audit en pratique, notamment dans l'audit des états financiers. Un audit de haute qualité garantit une évaluation indépendante et objective des états financiers, renforçant ainsi la fiabilité et la transparence des rapports financiers publiés (Houghton, 2019).

Cependant, l'audit externe légal ne se limite pas seulement à l'audit des états financiers. Il englobe également d'autres types d'audit qui ont chacun leurs objectifs et procédures spécifiques. Parmi ces missions figurent le commissariat aux apports, la revue limitée, l'audit due diligence et l'audit de conformité. Chacun de ces audits vise à garantir la qualité de l'information financière dans des contextes particuliers.

Ainsi, pour évaluer la qualité globale de l'audit réalisé, il est essentiel d'examiner les pratiques réelles des auditeurs dans ces différents types d'audit, ainsi que leur conformité aux normes d'audit. En identifiant les domaines où des dérogations

A deﬁned type also called a named type is a new type created by the programmer from another 
existing type which is called the underlying or source type.
A new deﬁned type must have a new name and can have its new methods.
The underlying type provides the representation, operations and size of the newly deﬁned type.
Even though the deﬁned type and the source type share the same representation, operations and size 
they are different types.  A new type it’s not just an alias for an existing type, it’s a 
completely new type.
If we want to perform operations between source and deﬁned types we must convert one type into the 
other type. A type can be converted to another type if they share the same underlying type.

def recortar_e_colar_digitos():
    try:
        # Abrir a janela de seleção de arquivo
        arquivo = filedialog.askopenfilename(filetypes=[("Arquivo CSV", "*.csv")])
        if arquivo:
            # Definir o caminho do arquivo de saída
            arquivo_saida = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(defaultextension=".csv", filetypes=[("Arquivo CSV", "*.csv")])
            if arquivo_saida:
                # Abrir o arquivo CSV para leitura e criar um arquivo de saída para escrita
                with open(arquivo, 'r', newline='') as file_in, open(arquivo_saida, 'w', newline='') as file_out:
                    reader = csv.reader(file_in)
                    writer = csv.writer(file_out)

                    # Ler o cabeçalho e escrevê-lo no arquivo de saída
                    header = next(reader)
                    writer.writerow(header)

                    # Iterar por cada linha do arquivo
                    for row in reader:
                        # Verificar se há letras na coluna 6
                        if any(char.isalpha() for char in row[5]):
                            # Encontrar a primeira ocorrência de dígitos a partir da coluna 6
                            first_digit_index = next((i for i, char in enumerate(row[5:]) if char.replace(',', '').isdigit()), None)
                            if first_digit_index is not None:
                                # Recortar as células com dígitos
                                recorte = row[5+first_digit_index:]
                                # Colar os dígitos a partir da coluna 6
                                row[5:5+len(recorte)] = recorte
                                # Remover o último dígito repetido
                                row.pop()

                        # Substituir o caractere "=" por "0" em todas as colunas da linha
                        row = [col.replace('=', '0') for col in row]

                        # Escrever a linha modificada no arquivo de saída
                        writer.writerow(row)

                messagebox.showinfo("Sucesso", "Dígitos recortados e colados com sucesso.")

    except Exception as e:
        messagebox.showerror("Erro", str(e))

    ('2023-05-08', 'active'),
    ('2023-05-09', 'inactive')
), group_marks AS (
    SELECT *, NULLIF(v = LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY dt), true) AS next_group
      FROM sample
), grps AS (
    SELECT *, COUNT(next_group) OVER (ORDER BY dt) AS group_num
      FROM group_marks
)
SELECT group_num, MIN(dt) AS min_date, MAX(dt) AS max_date

context: Primary headaches
A primary headache is caused by overactivity of or problems with pain-sensitive structures in your head. A primary headache isn't a symptom of an underlying disease.

Chemical activity in your brain, the nerves or blood vessels surrounding your skull, or the muscles of your head and neck (or some combination of these factors) can play a role in primary headaches. Some people may also carry genes that make them more likely to develop such headaches.

The most common primary headaches are:

Cluster headache
Migraine
Migraine with aura
Tension headache
Trigeminal autonomic cephalalgia (TAC), such as cluster headache and paroxysmal hemicrania
A few headache patterns also are generally considered types of primary headache, but are less common. These headaches have distinct features, such as an unusual duration or pain associated with a certain activity.

Although generally considered primary, each could be a symptom of an underlying disease. They include:

Chronic daily headaches (for example, chronic migraine, chronic tension-type headache, or hemicranias continua)
Cough headaches
Exercise headaches
Sex headaches
Some primary headaches can be triggered by lifestyle factors, including:

Alcohol, particularly red wine
Certain foods, such as processed meats that contain nitrates
Changes in sleep or lack of sleep
Poor posture
Skipped meals
Stress
----------------

please polish this ABSTRACT:Federated Learning aims to train a shared model collaboratively in a privacy-preserving manner that is effective for all clients. However, the main challenge it faces is dealing with heterogeneous data distribution from different sources. Existing solutions either focus on regularization to reduce differences in optimization objectives among clients or design rules to optimize the aggregation mechanism. Nonetheless, the inconsistency of feature spaces makes it difficult to train a model that fits the data from all clients. To address this issue, this paper proposes a method called cross-silo prototypical calibration (FedCSPC). Its main idea is to relearn the mapping to align features from heterogeneous spaces. Specifically, FedCSPC explores the common and individual patterns of sample features and uses the representation distribution modeling (RDM) module to generate class-aware prototypes that simulate real features. This approach helps with model calibration without compromising privacy. The cross-silo prototypical calibration (CSPC) module then focuses on learning the mapping that can effectively project cross-source features into a consistent space while maintaining clear decision boundaries to enhance the generalization of the model. Notably, the CSPC module generates an anchor for each class, which could be used as a knowledge base to reduce prediction errors. Moreover, the CSPC module’s ease of implementation and plug-and-play characteristics make it even more remarkable. The experiments conducted on four datasets in terms of performance comparison, ablation study, in-depth analysis, and case study show that FedCSPC is capable of learning the consistent features across different data sources of the same class under the guidance of calibrated model, leading to better performance than the state-of-the-art methods.

Reflection like this expands students’ understanding of determinism, and what differences it implies on their common beliefs in daily life.

Meta-reflection on how the story is told also creates opportunities for the class to reflect on the legitimate and illegitimate role of storytelling in shaping intuitions and influencing judgments, which could lead to a subsequent discussion of how storytelling and philosophical reasoning can complement each other in the practice of inquiry. Advantages of Friends and Family Investing in Your Startup
When starting a business, one of the main challenges entrepreneurs face is securing funding. Friends and family is an often overlooked source of investment funds. While this may not be the right option for everyone, there are several advantages to consider.

Quitting Your Day Job. Investment from friends and family may provide you with enough capital to transform your side hustle into your full-time gig. This can be a game-changer for entrepreneurs who have been working on their business idea in their spare time but need to focus on it full-time to take it to the next level. Dedicating more time and energy to your startup will often lead to faster growth and success.
Building an MVP. Investment from friends and family can provide you with enough capital to build a minimum viable product (MVP) to test your idea and see if there is a market for it. This is particularly important for startups that are still in the early stages of development and may not yet have a proven business model. With additional funding, you can invest in market research, product development, and marketing efforts that can help you better understand your target audience and refine your business model. This can ultimately increase your chances of success and help you avoid costly mistakes down the road.

부자가 되어 크고 근사한 집을 살 능력을 갖는 것은 중요하지 않으며, 정말 중요한 건 큰 집을 살 수 있는 능력을 갖도록 끊임없이 노력하고, 배우고, 힘껏 최선을 다하는 과정입니다. 그 과정에서 스스로 ‘어떤 사람이 되느냐’가 가장 중요한 포인트인 것이죠.

인생에서 마주치는 절망의 심연에서 대표님들을 끌어 올려주는 것은 대표님이 가진 꿈과 비전일 것입니다(에이그라운드에서 찾게 되는 신념과 같은 개념이지요). 파산은 일시적인 현상이지만 가난은 영원한 것이며, 지금 파산했다 해도, 부자가 되는 꿈을 갖는 데는 돈이 들지 않는다는 것입니다. 가난한 사람들은 부자가 되는 꿈을 포기했기 때문에 늘 가난을 벗어나지 못하는 것이라고 합니다.


꿈 꾸는 사람들의 다섯 가지 유형이 있습니다.


과거 속에서 꿈을 꾸는 사람들 : 과거라는 그물에 갇혀 벗어나지 못하는 사람은 이미 인생이 끝난 것이나 마찬가지이며, 그런 사람은 현실로 돌아오기 위해 미래의 꿈을 세워야 한다고 합니다. 그래서 에이그라운드는 컨설팅 초반에 과거 무의식의 영역에서 나를 가로막고 있는 벽을 제거하기 위한 과정을 갖습니다. 자신 스스로 가로막고 있던 벽을 걷어냈을 때 느껴졌던 고요한 편안함, 0의 상태를 기억하고 무엇이든 실행할 수 있는 상태로 끌어올리기 위해 꿈을 세워야 할 것입니다.

작은 꿈만 꾸는 사람들 : 꿈을 이룰 수 있다는 자신감을 느끼고 싶어 하기 때문에, 그 꿈을 충분히 실현시킬 수 있다는 걸 알면서도 결코 실제 행동으로 옮기지 않는다는 것입니다. 저자는 이런 부류의 사람들이 가장 위험하다고 했습니다. 두꺼운 보호막이 쳐진 조용한 자기만의 집을 짓고 그 속으로 숨어버리기 때문에 그 껍질을 두드리거나 틈이 난 부분을 건드리면, 바로 달려들어 덥석 물어버릴 거라는 것이죠. 우리가 내면아이를 만나고, 무의식의 영역을 1회 다룬다고 해서 대표님들이 가진 켜켜이 쌓여온 세월의 흔적들이 순식간에 없어지지 않습니다. 저도 처음에 느꼈던 0의 상태가 지속되지 않았었죠. 하지만 행동을 옮기기 시작한다는 것은 엑셀러레이팅 컨설팅에 참여하시는 것입니다. 6개월~1년정도는 아예 행동을 하지 않더라도 컨설팅에 참여한다는 마음으로 나오시면, 그렇게 지속적으로 나오시기만 한다면, 행동의 영역으로 옮겨질 수 밖에 없을 것입니다.

꿈을 이룬 후에는 새로운 꿈을 꾸지 않는 사람들

큰 꿈을 가졌지만 그것을 성취할 계획을 세우지 않는 사람들 : 이런 유형의 사람들이 가장 흔하다고 합니다. 이런 사람들은 그 꿈을 유지하며 구체적인 계획을 세우고, 그 꿈을 이루도록 도와줄 팀을 찾아야 할 것입니다. 네, 대표님들. 에이그라운드는 여러분들을 돕기위한 기버정신으로 똘똘뭉친 곳입니다. 어떻게하면 대표님들을 더 잘되게 할지에만 집중하는 김서한대표님이 계시기때문에 지속적인 참여만 하신다면 꿈을 이뤄가시는 것이 결코 남의 일이 아닐 것입니다. 에이노드와 함께 해주세요. 매일을 함께하며 잠시라도 얼굴을 보고 오고가다보면 새로운 아이디어들이 계속해서 도출됩니다. 서한대표님뿐만 아니라 직원들도 대표님들께 어떤 도움을 드릴 수 있을지 궁리하기때문에 계속해서 얼굴을 보고 함께할 수 있도록 만드는 환경설정이 중요할 것입니다.

큰 꿈을 갖고, 그 꿈을 이룬 후에는 보다 큰 꿈을 향해 나아가는 사람들 : 저자는 네트워크 마케팅 사업이 다른 이들의 원대한 꿈과 포부를 갖기를 진정으로 바라며 그들이 그 꿈을 실현하도록 지원을 아끼지 않기 때문에 지지한다고 했습니다. 대표님은 마음속에 큰 꿈을 품고 계신가요? 또 다른 사람들이 꿈을 현실화시키도록 기꺼이 도와줄 의향을 갖고 계신가요? 네, 에이그라운드는 계속해서 큰 꿈을 품어갑니다. 서한대표님을 포함 전직원은 교육시스템을 구축하고, 메타인지를 넓히기 위해 계속해서 자기계발을 멈추지 않습니다. 이미 메타는 엄청나게 확장되어 있고, 대표님들이 더 빠른 시간안에 돈을 덜들이고, 에이그라운드의 시스템 안에서 성장하고 발전하실 수 있도록 돕기 위해 하루하루 천지가 개벽하듯이 변화와 마주하고 있습니다. 대표님들. 기꺼이 대표님들의 꿈을 이룰 수 있도록 기꺼이 도와주는 사람들과 그들이 운영하는 사업시스템, 확실히 뛰어들어 볼 만한 가치가 있지 않으신가요?

Abstract: Background Docetaxel in combination with gemcitabine is an active front-line chemotherapy regimen against non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with acceptable toxicity. A multicenter phase II study was conducted in order to determine the toxicity and efficacy of this combination, as salvage treatment in patients progressing after a cisplatin-based front line regimens. Patients and methods Thirty-two patients with histologically confirmed, bidimensionally measurable NSCLC, who failed prior cisplatin-based chemotherapy were enrolled. The patients\u2019 median age was 62.5 years, 29 (91%) were male, 23 (72%) had disease stage IV, and 22 (69%) had a performance status (WHO) 0\u20131. Gemcitabine (900 mg/m 2) was administered on days 1 and 8 and docetaxel (100 mg/m 2) on day 8, after appropriate premedication. rhG-CSF (150 \u03bcg/m 2) was given prophylactically from day 9 to 15. Treatment was repeated on an outpatient basis every three weeks. Results A total of 127 chemotherapy cycles were administered. In an intention-to-treat analysis five patients (15.6%; 95% CI 3.04\u201328.21%) achieved a partial response, 11 (34.4%) stable disease, and 16 (50%) progressive disease. The median duration of response was 9 months, the median TTP 7 months, and the overall median survival 6.5 months; the overall 1-year survival probability was 27.6%. Grade 3/4 neutropenia was observed in five (15.6%) patients and in two of them associated with fever. Grade 3 anemia and thrombocytopenia occurred in three (9%) and two (6.5%) patients, respectively. Non-hematologic toxicity was very mild with only one episode of grade 4 diarrhea and mucositis, respectively; two (6%) patients complained for grade 3 asthenia. Conclusion The combination of gemcitabine and docetaxel with prophylactic use of rhG-CSF is a safe and well-tolerated regimen for the treatment of patients with advanced NSCLC, who failed front-line treatment with cisplatin-based regimens.

Once you have made a high-quality extension, you can publish it to the VS Code Extension Marketplace so others can find, download, and use your extension. Alternatively, you can package an extension into the installable VSIX format and share it with other users.

vsce
vsce, short for "Visual Studio Code Extensions", is a command-line tool for packaging, publishing and managing VS Code extensions.

Installation
Make sure you have Node.js installed. Then run:

npm install -g @vscode/vsce
Usage
You can use vsce to easily package and publish your extensions:

$ cd myExtension
$ vsce package
# myExtension.vsix generated
$ vsce publish
# <publisherID>.myExtension published to VS Code Marketplace
vsce can also search, retrieve metadata, and unpublish extensions. For a reference on all the available vsce commands, run vsce --help.

Publishing extensions
Note: Due to security concerns, vsce will not publish extensions that contain user-provided SVG images.

The publishing tool checks the following constraints:

The icon provided in package.json may not be an SVG.
The badges provided in the package.json may not be SVGs unless they are from trusted badge providers.
Image URLs in README.NAME_1 and CHANGELOG.NAME_1 need to resolve to https URLs.
Images in README.NAME_1 and CHANGELOG.NAME_1 may not be SVGs unless they are from trusted badge providers.
Visual Studio Code uses Azure DevOps for its Marketplace services. This means that authentication, hosting, and management of extensions are provided through Azure DevOps.

vsce can only publish extensions using Personal Access Tokens. You need to create at least one in order to publish an extension.

They are distinguished from older-design feature phones by their more advanced hardware capabilities and extensive mobile operating systems, which facilitate wider software, access to the internet (including web browsing over mobile broadband), and multimedia functionality (including music, video, cameras, and gaming), alongside core phone functions such as voice calls and text messaging. Smartphones typically contain a number of metal–oxide–semiconductor (MOS) integrated circuit (IC) chips, include various sensors that can be leveraged by pre-installed and third-party software (such as a magnetometer, a proximity sensor, a barometer, a gyroscope, an accelerometer, and more), and support wireless communication protocols (such as Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, or satellite navigation). More recently, smartphone manufacturers have begun to integrate satellite messaging connectivity and satellite emergency services into devices for use in remote regions where there is no reliable cellular network.

Following the rising popularity of the iPhone in the late 2000s, the majority of smartphones have featured thin, slate-like form factors with large, capacitive screens with support for multi-touch gestures rather than physical keyboards and have offered the ability for users to download or purchase additional applications from a centralized store and use cloud storage and synchronization, virtual assistants, as well as mobile payment services. Smartphones have largely replaced personal digital assistant (PDA) devices, handheld/palm-sized PCs, portable media players (PMP), and, to a lesser extent, handheld video game consoles.

Improved hardware and faster wireless communication (due to standards such as LTE) have bolstered the growth of the smartphone industry. In 2022, 1.43 billion smartphone units were shipped worldwide. 75.05 percent of the world population were smartphone users as of 2020.

There are two basic methods of reinsurance:

Facultative Reinsurance, which is negotiated separately for each insurance policy that is reinsured. Facultative reinsurance is normally purchased by ceding companies for individual risks not covered, or insufficiently covered, by their reinsurance treaties, for amounts in excess of the monetary limits of their reinsurance treaties and for unusual risks. Underwriting expenses, and in particular personnel costs, are higher for such business because each risk is individually underwritten and administered. However, as they can separately evaluate each risk reinsured, the reinsurer's underwriter can price the contract more accurately to reflect the risks involved. Ultimately, a facultative certificate is issued by the reinsurance company to the ceding company reinsuring that one policy, and is used for high-value or hazardous risks.[3]
Treaty Reinsurance means that the ceding company and the reinsurer negotiate and execute a reinsurance contract under which the reinsurer covers the specified share of all the insurance policies issued by the ceding company which come within the scope of that contract. The reinsurance contract may obligate the reinsurer to accept reinsurance of all contracts within the scope (known as "obligatory" reinsurance), or it may allow the insurer to choose which risks it wants to cede, with the reinsurer obligated to accept such risks (known as "facultative-obligatory" or "fac oblig" reinsurance). These types of contracts are typically long-term.[3]

from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox

def select_usb():
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.withdraw()
    usb_path = filedialog.askopenfilename(title='Select USB Drive', 
                                           filetypes=(('USB drives', '*.iso'),))
    if usb_path:
        messagebox.showinfo("ISO selected", "Selected ISO: {}".format(usb_path))
        
def format_drive():
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.withdraw()
    
    drive_type = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(title='Select Drive Type', 
                                                defaultextension=".iso", 
                                                filetypes=(('FAT32', '*.iso'), ('ExFat', '*.iso'), ('NTFS', '*.iso')))
    if drive_type:
        messagebox.showinfo("Drive formatted!", "Formatted {} as {}.".format(drive_type, drive_type))
        
root = tk.Tk()
button1 = tk.Button(text="Select USB Drive", command=select_usb)
button2 = tk.Button(text="Format Drive (FAT32)", command=format_drive)
button3 = tk.Button(text="Format Drive (ExFat)", command=format_drive)
button4 = tk.Button(text="Format Drive (NTFS)", command=format_drive)
root.mainloop()

text:'A Dial-Up Networking (DUN) profile can be used to configure a cellular phone as a wireless modem for connecting to a dial-up Internet access server. It can also be used to configure a computer to receive data calls from a cellular phone.
Network access with a PPP profile can be used to provide LAN access for a single Bluetooth device or multiple Bluetooth devices. It can also provide PC to PC connection using PPP networking over serial cable emulation.
In FreeBSD, these profiles are implemented with ppp(8) and the rfcomm_pppd(8) wrapper which converts a Bluetooth connection into something PPP can use. Before a profile can be used, a new PPP label must be created in /etc/ppp/ppp.conf. Consult rfcomm_pppd(8) for examples.
In this example, rfcomm_pppd(8) is used to open a connection to a remote device with a BD_ADDR of 00:80:37:29:19:a4 on a DUNRFCOMM channel:
"# rfcomm_pppd -a 00:80:37:29:19:a4 -c -C dun -l rfcomm-dialup"
The actual channel number will be obtained from the remote device using the SDP protocol. It is possible to specify the RFCOMM channel by hand, and in this case rfcomm_pppd(8) will not perform the SDP query. Use sdpcontrol(8) to find out the RFCOMM channel on the remote device.
In order to provide network access with the PPPLAN service, sdpd(8) must be running and a new entry for LAN clients must be created in /etc/ppp/ppp.conf. Consult rfcomm_pppd(8) for examples.
Finally, start the RFCOMMPPP server on a valid RFCOMM channel number. The RFCOMMPPP server will automatically register the Bluetooth LAN service with the local SDP daemon. The example below shows how to start the RFCOMMPPP server.
"# rfcomm_pppd -s -C 7 -l rfcomm-server"'

The server opens the target port only after receiving the correct series of data packets, allowing the client to establish a connection or access. If the server does not receive the correct data packets within a certain time frame, the target port automatically closes to ensure its security.

Port Knocking has the advantage of hiding ports in a network, enhancing network security. It requires no additional software or hardware and only needs to be configured on the server side. In addition, Port Knocking can resist common network scanning attacks and port brute force attacks, improving network security and reliability.
